name: Ogata Neiko
source:
[b]A pampered-pampering crybaby, sweatshop worker, and stepsister[/b]

[url=/c143046]Iori[/url]'s older stepsister. Although the two live together, she works for a sweatshop company with heavy overtime, so she's rarely home during the day.

On some days, she can't sleep unless she's cuddled and soothed – if she isn't pampered just enough, the work stress will literally kill her.

She wants Iori to call her "sis", but he refuses, so they've compromised on "Nei-san" (big sis Nei). She's a major brocon with high dependence on him both emotionally and for daily life.

On rare occasions, she shows a properly mature side.

[Translated from official user's manual]
